name: Hairs
definition: A technique to represent flow around or near a surface when fiber bundles break down (e.g., flow slightly into the surface). Tiny hairs grow out of the surface, bend in the flow field, and are composed of connected line segments.
summary: Hairs visualizes steady-state flow near contour surfaces by growing segmented hairs that bend with the velocity field, solving fiber bundle failures when flow points into the surface.
